announcement.msg_id: ARA 4.2.6 sudah tersedia — kualitas foto diperbaiki: karakter profil kamera, grade editorial, dan film grain kini benar-benar terkirim ke Gemini (sebelumnya diam-diam hilang di mode render/3D). Kalau kamu tidak melihat tawaran update otomatis, unduh manual di github.com/gigihwicaksono09-spec/ARA_AURUM/releases — versi masa coba dan edisi portable memang tidak dapat update otomatis.
announcement.msg_en: ARA 4.2.6 is available — photographic quality fixes: camera-profile character, editorial grade, and film grain now actually reach Gemini (they were silently dropped in render/3D mode). If you don't see an automatic update prompt, download it manually at github.com/gigihwicaksono09-spec/ARA_AURUM/releases — trial installs and the portable edition don't receive automatic updates.
